headline: Macy's holds its very first parade

scenes.text: [warmly] On this day, in nineteen twenty-four... Macy's held its first parade in New York.

scenes.label: Macy's, Herald Square
scenes.caption: The store's entrance, 1908
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Store workers marched six miles, to Herald Square.

scenes.label: people lined the route
scenes.text: [calmly] More than two hundred fifty thousand people came to watch.

scenes.label: Macy's holiday window
scenes.caption: Children at a Christmas display
scenes.text: [gently] No giant balloons yet... just real elephants, camels and bears from the Central Park Zoo.

scenes.title: Balloons arrived in 1927
scenes.text: [warmly] Balloons took over in nineteen twenty-seven.

scenes.title: Do you still watch it?
scenes.text: [gently] Do you still watch it every year?
